test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

How do you think the internet __has influenced how we utilise__ news and media?

options.text: has managed the patterns we ingest
has revoked the way we interact
has impacted the way we consume

solution:
The correct answer is: "**has impacted the way we consume**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Impacted**" means to have a strong effect on something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति पर गहरा प्रभाव डालना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The economic downturn impacted businesses, leading to layoffs and financial struggles.*
 
 
 
• The sentence is asking about how the internet has influenced our use of news and media.
 
• "**Consume**" means to use or take in something, in this case, news and media. (किसी चीज़ का उपयोग करना या लेना)
 
 
• **Example**: *His passion for environmental issues consumed him, driving him to dedicate his life to sustainability initiatives.*
 
 

Therefore, **Option 4** is the most appropriate substitution for the underlined words.
